decisions.reason: Although it vanished from visible promotion after 2019, transactional email is tightly aligned with the firm's core cloud messaging direction, so management would likely keep it as a strategically important option unless stronger evidence of weak demand emerges.

After several years without visible follow-up, this more adjacent document workflow offer appears to have revealed limited standalone value relative to the firm's core messaging stack, so resources are better reallocated.

As a close-to-core fax optimization feature with likely low carrying cost and continuing relevance for legacy and public-sector processes, it remains worth keeping open despite muted growth expectations.
Threat protection directly supports the firm's secure communications proposition and can plausibly be maintained as a bundled or cross-sold capability at modest incremental cost.

Given the lack of later visibility and overlap with broader email security capabilities, a separate multi-engine virus scanning offer looks less differentiated and no longer worth dedicated product attention.
